newsitem.title: FINLAND: POHJOLA TO CO-OPERATE WITH GERLING.
newsitem.headline: POHJOLA TO CO-OPERATE WITH GERLING.

text.p: Finnish insurance group Vakuutusosakeyhtio Pohjola said in a statement on Monday it will begin next year to cooperate with German insurer Gerling in the field of credit insurance.
The agreement covers insurance of short-term corporate sales receivables and focuses on exchange of information and development of risk management systems, Pohjola said.
"The intention is to expand the cooperation during 1997," it said, adding the agreement did not include ownership arrangements.
Both insurers will continue to handle separately their respective credit insurance operations, it said.
Pohjola said its ability to offer services to Finnish companies going internatinal would improve substantially when it will get access to Gerling's large contact network.
Including its Belgian subsidiary Namur, the Gerling group is Europe's third biggest credit insurer with 1995 credit insurance premiums written at 2.4 billion Finnish markka, Pohjola said.
Pohjola's own annual credit insurance premiums written are currently at around 20 million markka.
